name: Paint smoke
doc: A stable-fluid sim whose dye is the picture: its colours are carried off by the flow and curl into smoke, while the image keeps pulling the paint back home, so it re-forms when the music lets go. The paint circles along the picture's own luma contours (reversing every 4 bars) and bright paint rises; bass and onsets drive orbiting stirrers, each onset puffs a palette-tinted ring of paint, and loud passages loosen the pull home.

luma.doc: brightness map whose contours steer the flow (core-media.luma); without it, the luma of in

palette.doc: the onset puffs and the glow of freshly stirred paint

cells.doc: sim grid height in cells (width follows the aspect)

restore.doc: how fast the paint relaxes back to the picture (per second); loud music loosens it

smear.doc: how fast moved paint takes over from the crisp picture

paint.doc: share of the fluid's paint shown everywhere, moved or not

swirl.doc: flow along the picture's contours (driven by loudness)

stir.doc: force of the orbiting stirrers (driven by bass and onsets)

buoyancy.doc: bright paint rises, dark paint sinks

vorticity.doc: vorticity confinement: keeps the small curls

light.doc: relief lighting on the smeared paint

glow.doc: palette glow of freshly stirred paint
